noun_definition: login refers to the process of accessing an account on the platform by entering credentials, specifically in this case involving the use of a recovery code after two-factor authentication (2FA) is enabled.
Enter key refers to the key on the keyboard that, when pressed, is expected to submit the recovery code during the login process.
Recovery code refers to a backup code used to authenticate a user when two-factor authentication (2FA) is enabled, which is entered after selecting the option to use it during the login process.
